items.author: Jim Owczarski

images.alt:
UCO

We recognize the extraordinary circumstances surrounding the ground stoppage and understand the challenges it created for teams across the country. Just like every other team in the country other than Ole Miss, our opponents were able to find a solution. So today the University of Central Oklahoma will host Missouri Western in football at 1pm as scheduled. And tonight the Bronchos will host Oklahoma Christian in men's basketball at 7:30pm as scheduled.

I understand difficult decisions sometimes must be made in extraordinary circumstances, and those decisions must consider the impact on everyone involved. Therefore, I've made the decision that all SEC fans with nothing to do today in Norman may show their OU-Ole Miss game ticket to gain free admission for today's games at UCO.

If any SEC fans "explore every avenue" but are unable to find their way to Edmond, I invite them to tune in to the MIAA network and watch UCO's nationally ranked volleyball team play in the conference championship match at 6pm.

Roll 'Chos,
Stan
Vice President for Athletics
